title: Minimize and globally bound the retired Engram authority ledger
outcome: The host-level retired-authority ledger persists the raw work-authority grant even after revocation is confirmed and is bounded only per store identity. Because store identities are unbounded and survive project deletion/restart, ~/.termal/termal.sqlite can retain an unbounded collection of obsolete operator credentials. Preserve fail-closed retry/reuse semantics while replacing confirmed raw grants with an equality-safe digest, adding a global/age retention policy that never drops unconfirmed entries, and documenting the retention boundary.
acceptance: Confirmed entries retain no raw grant secret; unconfirmed entries remain retryable and are never evicted by normal bounds; total confirmed ledger growth is globally bounded or age-pruned; reuse rejection remains correct; persistence/reload and eviction tests pass; the feature brief documents the policy.
